t: Two things named as sources of help
a: وَٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلْخَـٰشِعِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
p: Wa-staʿīnū bi-ṣ-ṣabri wa-ṣ-ṣalāh, wa innahā la-kabīratun illā ʿala-l-khāshiʿīn.
m: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh] Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
